ja424:1.1: Ādittasmiṃ agārasmiṃ yaṃ nīharati bhājanaṃ (cfr. Saṃyutta p.) taṃ tassa hoti atthāya no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhati.
ja424:2.1: Evaṃ ādīpito loko jarāya maraṇena ca, nīhareth' eva dānena, dinnaṃ hi hoti nībhatan ti.
ja424:3.1: Yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ (cfr. Saṃyutta p. 20-22) uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatassa jantu (no) atikkamma so Vetaraṇiṃ Yamassa dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco.
ja424:4.1: Dānañ ca yuddhañ ca samānam āhu: appāpi santā bahuke jinanti, appam pi ce saddahāno dadāti ten' eva so hoti sukhī parattha.
ja424:5.1: Viceyya dānaṃ Sugata-ppasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette.
ja424:6.1: Yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayañ caraṃ parūpavādā na karoti pāpaṃ bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti, na hi tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karoti pāpaṃ.
ja424:7.1: Hīnena brahmacariyena khattiye upapajjati majjhimena ca devattaṃ, uttamena visujjhati.
ja424:8.1: Addhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ va seyyo, pubbe va hi pubbatar' eva santo nibbānam ev' ajjhagamū sapaññā ti
